short_description: Research public companies with current SandBase market data.
description: Analyze public companies and listed securities with current profile, price, ownership, filing, valuation, and analyst evidence discovered dynamically through SandBase.

requires: SandBase MCP connection or SANDBASE_API_KEY for live data

install.prompt: Use $stock-analysis to research this public company with current SandBase data.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill stock-analysis --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill stock-analysis --agent codex --global

examples: Analyze AAPL's one-year performance against the S&P 500 and explain the main risks.
Summarize the latest 10-K and recent insider activity for this ticker.
Compare three semiconductor stocks on price trend, company profile, and filing evidence.

required.label: SandBase MCP connection or API key

optional_inputs: requested financial, filing, or ownership evidence

notes: Supports the official SandBase MCP bridge and documented Bearer-authenticated REST API.
Discovers and inspects live capabilities instead of preserving Manus/Yahoo parameter snapshots.
Does not execute trades or provide personalized financial advice.
Never duplicates a pending asynchronous run.

endpoints.summary: Discover current stock and company-data capabilities.
Inspect live schemas, coverage, pricing, and execution requirements.
Execute an approved market-data or filing capability.
Recover recent run status and recorded cost.
Check balance before a paid multi-call batch.
